CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Javelin and Sculpture: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Javelin and Sculpture.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Javelin and Sculpture.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Javelin and Sculpture.
   D. Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork: (1 mark)

8. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

9. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)

10. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the volume

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Handball and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Storytelling and Animation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Football and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. D — Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. A — Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. B — Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. A — Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. B — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. D — Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. D — Red, blue, and yellow

9. C — Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. A — The speed of the music

11. D — Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. C — Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

15. (4 marks)

16. (4 marks)
